summary: Create PagerDuty service + routing rule for perf-canary regression alerts (page SRE, handoff to Runtime)
description:
Request
- Create a dedicated PagerDuty service for perf-canary performance regression alerts (p95 latency + tokens/sec regressions).
- Configure routing so SRE oncall is paged for initial triage, with clear handoff/escalation path to Serving Runtime on confirmation.

Background
Perf regression canary is entering Phase 1 rollout (us-east, 2–3 models). We need paging wired up before enabling alert rules in prod so we can validate payloads, dedup, and maintenance-window suppression.

Proposed PagerDuty setup
Service
- Name: "Perf Canary - Perf Regression"
- Description: Internal perf regression canary alerts (p95 latency + tokens/sec) emitted from observability-pack alert rules.
- Urgency: High

Escalation policy (proposal from #eng-sre)
- Level 1: SRE Oncall (Primary)
- Level 2: SRE Oncall (Secondary) after 10 minutes
- Level 3: Serving Runtime Oncall after 20 minutes (or earlier via manual reassignment when confirmed)

Event rules / dedup
- Dedup key: {alertname}:{model}:{region}:{gpu_sku}:{metric}
  - metric in {p95_latency, tokens_per_sec}
- Grouping: group by model+region+metric to avoid multi-page storms when gpu_sku fans out
- Suppression/maintenance windows: respect "deploy window" + "maintenance" labels coming from slo-toolkit helper (see related PR)

Integrations
- Source: Observability alertmanager -> PagerDuty Events API
- Also post to Slack via incident-bot webhook (separate from PD, but should share same dedup key fields)

Approval needed
- Sean Gallagher to approve paging policy + escalation
- Mateo Alvarez (Runtime sponsor) aware of Runtime-oncall escalation (FYI)

Acceptance criteria
1) PagerDuty service exists and is visible to SRE + Runtime leads.
2) Test event delivered end-to-end to SRE oncall (ack + note).
3) Documentation: add PD service link + escalation policy details to perf-regression-alert-policy page.
4) Confirm dedup keys prevent repeated pages on the same regression event.

Notes
- INT-3321 is tracking dashboard/metrics access grants for responders; please keep permissions aligned with least-privilege.
- This should ship before enabling prod alert rules from observability-pack/pr_851.
